doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Where the nickname Cheeks comes from
summary: The Cheeks nickname became common in the service as a term of affection, and he lets students call him Chico.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: And you’ve been using the name Cheeks. When did that come -- yet another nickname.
Well that started out -- it got real prevalent when I was in the service.

Cheeks. Well that’s the affection side. You heard of cheeks, you know, when guys are close. You know it’s a funny thing, at the school man, not only at the school but all over, people don’t know whether to call me Mr. Hamilton, or Chico, or, you know, that type of thing so I
just let everybody relax and say Chico with the school. That breaks all stereotypes, anybody -- you can’t make me old, man; I get old when I decide.
